plain.summary: Each Worker stands for the principal subject names, which beats it at least every 30 seconds; the runner misses one past its deadline within 5 seconds.

beat.useWhen: Use as the principal subject names, at least every 30 seconds, to show it is alive.
beat.success: Returns the new deadline; a missed instance is present again.

errors.commonCorrection: Beat the instance whose subject names you.
Set subject to the principal's subject first.

miss.useWhen: Use to apply the miss of an instance past its deadline; the runner's sweep does so within 5 seconds.
miss.success: Returns missed, false for an instance not past its deadline, and the leases it released, by schema.

update.doNotUseWhen: Do not change subject once it holds a principal.

errors.commonCorrection: Create a new instance for another principal.

full.summary: Each Worker stands for the principal subject names, which beats it at least every 90 seconds; the runner misses one past its deadline within 1500 ms. A miss moves status from idle or busy to missing. A miss expires the principal's leases on Job, Task and Build, but those renewed since its last beat. A beat moves status from missing to idle.

beat.useWhen: Use as the principal subject names, at least every 90 seconds, to show it is alive.
beat.success: Returns the new deadline; a missed instance is present again.

errors.commonCorrection: Beat the instance whose subject names you.
Set subject to the principal's subject first.

miss.useWhen: Use to apply the miss of an instance past its deadline; the runner's sweep does so within 1500 ms.
miss.success: Returns missed, false for an instance not past its deadline, and the leases it released, by schema.

update.doNotUseWhen: Do not change subject once it holds a principal.

errors.commonCorrection: Create a new instance for another principal.

one.summary: Each Worker stands for the principal who names, which beats it at least every 1 hour; the runner misses one past its deadline within 1 minute. A miss expires the principal's leases on Job, but those renewed since its last beat. A beat moves status from missing to idle.

beat.success: Returns the new deadline; a missed instance is present again.

errors.commonCorrection: Beat the instance whose who names you.
Set who to the principal's subject first.
